headline: Internal ALB will incur ongoing AWS charges not mentioned in the PR description
suppressed: Security reviewer confirmed proper isolation (no public subnets, internal=true scheme). Reliability reviewer confirmed correct configuration with no risk to existing infrastructure. Plain HTTP on port 8080 is documented as intentional for internal-only traffic between private subnets.

findings.evidence_ref: New aws_lb resource with internal=true on private subnets; ALB pricing includes hourly charges plus per-LCU billing for data processed
findings.explanation: Adding an Application Load Balancer introduces material recurring AWS costs (hourly charges plus per-capacity-unit billing). The PR description mentions the architecture change but not the cost impact or budget allocation.
